assumptions: CPSS exchangeability (Meinshausen-Buhlmann) over an adaptive learned pipeline is a modelling idealisation; the reality test provides an independent assumption-light check.
The universe is structure-level: supports of arity <= F_max per layer interface of the delivered topology.

routes.note: Routes are certified at the collinearity-group level (the level stable across retrainings); unit members are one carving from an explicit equivalence class.

function_decomposition.note: Purified weighted-fANOVA components of the learned function under the DECLARED empirical training measure (unique given the measure; carving-invariant).  Shares are out-of-sample covariances on validation.

non_claims: CORE concepts are stable, real structures - not proven causal mechanisms of the world (M-C7).
The periphery is labelled, not certified.
Unit semantics require expert review (the soft target).
